title: Data cleanup, step 1: find and preview what the old crawler made that fails today's rules
why: Jason, 2026-11-14 (through the session manager): "start" the build, stage 1b first, the data cleanup tool (decisions/0163 §8 stage 1b, 0164 §6.1b). This first release finds and previews only: nothing is written. New section Insights → Data cleanup (app/admin/cleanup-console.php, the library app/lib/DataCleanup.php). Press Preview for one rule or every rule: per rule, how many would change, how many are Check these (a person entered or decided something: never changed, R4) and how many are left, with examples linked to each record. Rules: listings (crawler-made, public) whose name is page text ("Contact Us:", "PO Box 190", webinar and form titles: a new junk-name check, DataCleanup::junkName); no address and no phone (to a sighting or the "Help us find this business" card, not built yet, so quarantine with that target); address and phone only from cite-only pages (to a sighting); values from OpenStreetMap only (re-source or unconfirmed); "Closed" set by the crawler on one site's word (caution with Still open?; its own website saying so is left, R12); likely duplicates (LiveDupes' test, merge offers). Staged finds with page-text names (quarantined status). The place store: page-text names, places SourceIndex::guard would hold but aren't marked, facts from cite-only sources. Landmarks: protected names shown on a machine's word (story only, P5-3), nation-sensitive kinds shown, Wikipedia text kept while its rule is cite only. Reads up to 6,000 of each store, newest first. Permissions insights.cleanup and insights.cleanup_undo (Executives by default) in System Configuration → Permissions. FAQ: two staff entries. No migration. The actions, ledger, Undo, Pulse case and the schedule hook (off) come in step 2, after Jason sees the preview counts.

items: No new fatal errors in the logs
